info.name: IIS Administration Application Pools API
info.description:
REST API for managing Internet Information Services (IIS) web servers. The IIS Administration API enables configuration and monitoring of IIS web sites, applications, and application pools from any HTTP client. Based on the Microsoft IIS Administration documentation at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/iis-administration/.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Support
 Email: support@microsoft.com

variable.description: (Required) The unique identifier of the application pool.

request.description: Retrieves the details of a specific application pool by its identifier.
